tasks.title: Reposition Changes panel and remove stage gate
tasks.description: In IssueDetailPage.tsx: (1) Remove the DIFF_STAGES constant and showDiff variable. (2) Move the Changes JSX block from after Comments to after Description, before TaskList. (3) Replace the IIFE with a direct render — show 'No changes yet' empty state card when files and commits are both empty, instead of returning null.
acceptanceCriteria: DIFF_STAGES constant and showDiff variable are removed
Changes panel renders in all stages including Backlog and Explore
Backlog/empty stage shows 'No changes yet' card without Files/Commits tabs
Layout order is BranchBar → Description → Changes → TaskList → Comments
No duplicate diff section after Comments
Existing Files/Commits tabs and expandable diff viewer still work in stages with data
Build passes (npm run build in packages/cli)
tasks.notes: Design D1: keep inline, don't extract component. Design D2: replace IIFE null-return with explicit empty state card.

tasks.title: Add summary statistics header to Changes panel
tasks.description: Add a one-line summary header inside the Changes panel (above the Files/Commits tabs) showing: N files, +X −Y lines, M commits. Compute totals by reducing over diffData.files for additions/deletions and commitsData.commits.length for commit count. Omit commit count segment when 0. Only show the summary header when there are changes — not in the 'No changes yet' empty state.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary header shows 'N files · +X −Y · M commits' format with green additions, red deletions
Commit count segment is omitted when 0 commits
Summary header is not shown in the empty state (no data)
Stats update when diff/commits data refreshes via React Query
Build passes (npm run build in packages/cli)
tasks.notes: Design D3: stats computed inline from existing diffData/commitsData. No new queries or memoization.
